title: World Capitals
description: Match countries from every continent to their capital cities

questions.question: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo has been the seat of Japan's government since 1868, when the imperial court moved there from Kyoto, the former capital.

questions.question: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa was chosen as the capital by Queen Victoria in 1857. Toronto and Montreal are larger cities but neither is the capital.

questions.question: What is the capital of Brazil?
questions.explanation: Brasília was purpose-built inland and became the capital in 1960, taking over from Rio de Janeiro. São Paulo is the country's largest city.

questions.question: What is the capital of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Cairo, on the Nile, is Egypt's capital and largest city. Alexandria is the main Mediterranean port and second largest city.

questions.question: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.explanation: Wellington became the capital in 1865 because of its central location. Auckland is the largest city and was the previous capital.

questions.question: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Ankara has been the capital since 1923, when the Republic of Turkey was founded. Istanbul is larger and was the capital of the Ottoman Empire.

questions.question: What is the capital of Kenya?
questions.explanation: Nairobi is Kenya's capital and largest city. Mombasa is the country's main port on the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: Amsterdam is the constitutional capital of the Netherlands, but which city is the seat of the Dutch government?
questions.explanation: The Dutch constitution names Amsterdam as the capital, but parliament, the ministries and the monarch's working palace are all in The Hague.

questions.question: What is the capital of South Korea?
questions.explanation: Seoul, in the north-west of the country, is South Korea's capital and by far its largest city. Busan is the biggest port.

questions.question: What is the capital of Norway?
questions.explanation: Oslo is Norway's capital and largest city. Stockholm is a plausible-looking option but it is the capital of Sweden.
